summary: Adds an embed viewer on custom domains, makes the Embed code modal use it, lets any site iframe /embed paths on custom domains, and refactors the link-session cookie name helper (no behavior change).

statements.why: No login/payment/db/secret problem; new page reuses existing viewer protections.

statements.text: The view domain embed page is new, titled "Page not found." ... sections for Welcome ... sends verification tokens ... deletes data ...
statements.why: It is an iframe-only embed viewer for links on a custom domain; the listed boxes/calls come from reused viewer components. Owner can't tell what the page is.

statements.text: The views part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet. /api/views
statements.why: Only swaps the literal cookie name for a helper returning the same string; no behavior change.

statements.text: The agent also changed embed-code-modal.tsx, links-table.tsx, link-session.ts and domain.ts, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: All four really changed (modal URL, cookie helper, frame-ancestors middleware).

statements.text: Type checking is turned off in 2 spots in embed.tsx (`any`).

misses.what: For links on a custom domain, the 'Embed code' modal now gives an iframe pointing to https://<custom-domain>/<slug>/embed; only works if the domain is set up and served by the app. Old embed codes keep working.
Custom-domain /<slug>/embed pages can now be framed by any website (frame-ancestors * in lib/middleware/domain.ts), same as default-domain embeds.
Inside an embed on the same root domain the viewer's session cookie now works so downloads work.
